periods.label: 钢铁狂熊被烈风剑帝碾碎

status.current: defeated by Ouma and saved from death by Kurono's emergency time stop
status.condition: limbs severed and heart crushed before regenerative treatment

personality.summary: Boisterous, brave and direct, proud of the body he built to challenge Ouma.

relationships.ouma-kurogane: Childhood rival whom Renji has trained five years to challenge again.
relationships.shinguji-kurono: Saves his life by freezing his body after Ouma crushes his heart.

periods.summary: Renji enters the third round as the only returning top-eight veteran, wearing only his Device mawashi to show resolve. He demonstrates enormous control by stamping the arena downward without cracking it, then reveals his hidden Iron Block Asura Statue, forming extra steel arms to triple his offense and defense. He charges Ouma and lands blows, but Ouma only lowers his body to draw his sword. Renji's six-armed Asura Hyakka Palm cannot move Ouma, and Ouma cuts off his limbs before crushing his heart. Kurono's Clock Lock and the regenerative capsule prevent his death.

key_events.summary: Unveils Asura Statue but is catastrophically defeated by Ouma.
